name: Browser Terminal Use
description: Control a browser terminal tab from a local CLI through a localhost bridge.

action.default_title: Bind this tab as Browser Terminal

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ws://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*
